$description: Source of truth. Everything downstream is emitted, never hand-edited. Replace every REPLACE marker; delete groups the archetype does not need rather than leaving them empty.

primitive.$description: Tier 1. Raw values, no meaning. Referencing these from product code is a lint error.

neutral.$description: The ramp that carries most of the interface. Decide its temperature deliberately — warm, cool, or true — it sets the feel more than the accent does.

accent.$description: Tune per hue rather than stepping lightness mechanically — mechanical ramps read muddy in the mid tones.

space.$description: The base unit comes from the density axis of the extraction; every step is a multiple of it. Fixed count, fixed keys. The rules for which value applies where live in the docs, not here.

1.$value: REPLACE — one base unit, the tightest gap in the system

3.$value: REPLACE — 3 base units, the default control padding

4.$value: REPLACE — 4 base units, the default block gap

16.$value: REPLACE — 16 base units, the largest gap the system allows

radius.$description: Derived from the geometry axis of the extraction.

pill.$value: REPLACE — fully rounded; delete this token if the geometry has no fully-rounded form

text.$description: Fixed number of steps. If a mock needs a size between two steps, the mock is wrong.

2xs.$value: REPLACE — smallest legible label; two steps below base

xs.$value: REPLACE — metadata and captions; one step below sm

sm.$value: REPLACE — secondary body, just under base

base.$value: REPLACE — 14px for dense tools, 16px for reading

md.$value: REPLACE — emphasised body, one step above base

xl.$value: REPLACE — section heading; ratio from the typographic contrast of the direction

2xl.$value: REPLACE — display; how loud depends on how expressive the direction is

duration.$description: Derived from the motion character of the direction. A system with little motion keeps these short, or deletes the group.

instant.$value: REPLACE — state flips that should read as immediate

moderate.$value: REPLACE — entrances and exits of small surfaces

slow.$value: REPLACE — the largest movement the direction permits

semantic.$description: Tier 2. The theming seam. Dark mode and alternate brands remap ONLY this tier.

surface.$description: Default raised surface — panels, cards, rows.

text-primary.$description: Must clear 4.5:1 on surface in every theme.

text-secondary.$description: Must clear 4.5:1 — this is the pair that usually fails.

action-solid.$description: Primary control fill. If colour is reserved for state, this is ink rather than a hue.

focus.$description: Must clear 3:1 against every surface it can appear on.

state.$description: Delete this group entirely if colour does not carry meaning in this product. Each level needs foreground, background, and an edge colour, and each must pair with a non-colour signal.

elevation.$description: Tie levels to meaning, not blur radii. If the separation device is rules rather than shadow, keep these near-invisible.

z.$description: Named and exhaustive so nobody writes 9999. Ordering encodes a real decision — decide whether toasts sit above modals and why.

component.$description: Tier 3. The density seam. Density modes remap ONLY this tier. Dimensions only — component-scoped colour tokens multiply without earning anything.

table.$description: Delete if the archetype has no tables.

$themes.$description: Each theme overrides semantic only. If a theme needs to touch tier 1 or tier 3, the tiering is wrong.
